title: Two-Point Noise Hypercontractivity
statement: Let $1\le p\le2$, let $0\le\rho\le\sqrt{p-1}$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}\to\mathbb R$. With respect to the uniform probability measure on the sign set, the $L^2$ norm of the sign noise operator applied to $f$ is at most the $L^p$ norm of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign set
